A field guide to an inhabited world · volume XVI · the dragon family

Dragons

Seven dragon monster girls: the long dragon who swims through the sky, the great serpent Jormungandr, the fire-breathing wyrm, the gryphon, the little dragon Kannae, the wyvern with wings for arms and the eight-headed Yamata no Orochi. The strongest family of all, and the proudest.

Favourite food: Cooked meat (steak above all); golden apples as a treat

I · HarpiesII · Bullywugs & Mucus ToadsIII · NekomataIV · KitsuneV · LamiaVI · ArachneVII · CentaursVIII · MerfolkIX · SlimesX · JackalopesXI · MinotaursXII · MollusksXIII · ElvesXIV · UndeadXV · LizardfolkXVI · DragonsXVII · DevilsXVIII · BugsXIX · FloraXX · CanidsXXI · RodentsXXII · CrustaceansXXIII · MarsupialsXXIV · ArmouredXXV · ConstructsXXVI · BatsXXVII · TheropodsXXVIII · The Four Riders
The central similarity

Pride and power.

Every dragon is stronger than anything else her size, and knows it. They are not hostile, but they expect respect: a gift of good food, and never a blow.

  • FlightMost of them fly (the long dragon swims through the air; the wyvern and wyrm on wings).
  • HoardsEvery dragon keeps a hoard: she collects gold, gems and shiny things into a chest near her lair.
  • BreathThe wyrm breathes fire; Kannae calls lightning; the long dragon brings rain.
  • SteakThe family food: cooked meat. A golden apple wins her heart.

Relationships (shared by every family)

The same relationship core runs through all MonsterGirls families, from the harpies on. This volume only changes how a dragon builds trust, what she gives back, and how she bears young.

AffectionEach monster girl remembers every player separately. Feeding, petting and her family's own bond action raise it; hurting her lowers it. /monstergirls bonds lists everyone nearby.
SitRight-click any monster girl with a plain stick to make her sit; again to let her get up.
Sharing a bedAt high friendship (25) she may join you in bed: once a night she decides, one in three at 25, certain at 100. Sleep through the night and she is expecting.
ExpectingA pregnancy lasts one in-game day. Her belly rounds out as it goes on (the model shows it).
Born devotedHer young are born devoted to the player who fathered them (full affection) and never share that player's bed.
PresentsAt high friendship every family brings presents of its own kind.
BondAffectionWhat it means
Wild0Keeps her distance; her species' instincts decide everything.
Curious3+Lets you come close and watches what you do.
Fond10+Follows you a little way, accepts petting, stops fleeing.
High friendship25+May join you in bed at night (one night in three, more the fonder she is) and brings presents.
Devoted60+The family's devoted perk unlocks (see each guide).
Full devotion100The most there is. Every daughter feels this for the player who fathered her.

Friendship

What builds trust

  • Cooked meat (+1), steak (+2), golden apples (+4)
  • Gold and gems for her hoard (+2)
  • Respect: never hitting her

What costs trust

  • Hitting her (a dragon does not forget)
  • Taking from her hoard

Devoted (60+)

She shares her strength: Strength and Fire Resistance near her, and her hoard opens to you.

Mating & young

FormA single dragon egg. YoungA hatchling, grown in 5 days. WhereHer lair, kept warm. Hatchlings use the adult model at 45%.

1. CourtshipAt high friendship she may share your bed (a dragon decides when).
2. The eggShe lays one large dragon egg in her lair (a girl egg block).
3. HatchingIt hatches after a day if kept warm (near fire or lava).
4. GrownThe hatchling grows up in five days, devoted to her father.

Behaviour & gameplay (shared by the family)

FlyingThe long dragon, the wyrm, the wyvern and the gryphon fly; Kannae hovers a little; Jormungandr and Orochi stay on the ground.
HoardA dragon picks up gold, gems and shiny items she finds and stores them in the nearest chest of her lair.
Fire breathThe wyrm breathes a cone of fire at enemies (sets them alight).
LightningKannae calls down a lightning bolt on an enemy once in a while.
RidingThe gryphon (and, at full devotion, the wyrm) lets her player ride and fly.
Many headsYamata no Orochi's seven dragon heads each bite: she hits every enemy around her at once.

Long (about 2.6 blocks)

TemperamentSerene, wise, mostly neutral

Ecology & behaviourA Chinese dragon: a long serpentine body that swims through the sky, a mane, antlers and whiskers.

Signature: Rain bringerShe flies slowly and ominously in high circles. A devoted long dragon can bring rain to dry farmland (once a day).

Player interactionOffer meat at a high place; never startle her.

In the game

Built (2026-10-19)

  • Amphiptere: speeds her friend's elytra. Ender Dragon: fills bottles with dragon's breath
  • Bahamut: flies; befriended, once a day a beam of light strikes every monster around her friend
  • Nenekea: befriended, her hurt friend near her heals while they stand in water
  • Moo: befriended, when monsters crowd her friend she stands with them (Strength). Hairypterix: flies; befriended, her falling friend drifts down gently
  • Hoards gold and gems into a chest near her lair (gifts +2)
  • Long, wyrm, gryphon and wyvern fly
  • Long dragon brings rain for a devoted friend
  • Jormungandr: coils (Slowness IV), arrows do a third
  • Wyrm: fire breath
  • Gryphon: carries a friend through the air (high friendship); the wyrm at full devotion
  • Kannae: lightning on enemies, follows her friend
  • Wyvern: poison sting
  • Orochi: every head bites everything around her; honey makes her drowsy (+3)
  • Devoted: Fire Resistance, Strength in a fight
  • Chimera: burns and poisons
  • Kun: flies; once a day she catches her friend from the void
  • Quetzalcoatl: on the rearing serpent's rig, she flies; befriended, at dawn she ripens the crops near her friend
  • Macawtl: flies; befriended, out under the open sky her friend near her runs faster (Speed)
  • Cockatrice: flies; befriended, her glare stops a monster near her friend almost dead
  • Alebrije: flies; befriended, she now and then dyes a sheep near her, and her presents are dyes

Not yet

  • Burning blocks with the fire breath
  • A big dragon egg block

Design decisions log

Decided (2026-10-19)

  • Dragons are neutral, not hostile: strong, proud, and slow to forgive.

Open questions

  • Should the wyrm's fire breath burn blocks?
